text:
Anita: Heads-up: we're scheduling a shadow roll of the updated price sheet into the sandbox cohort tonight (22:00 PT). This is the A/B price experiment (variant X vs baseline). Need billing + vendor signoff before we expose traffic.
Leo: Do we have a vendor SLA confirmation? and will invoices show both old/new line items or a single effective price?
VendorRep: Confirmed: SLA unchanged. For invoices the plan is to emit shadow invoices (no billing) with line-item diffs. Live invoices won't change unless we promote.
Priya: Grandfathering question: which accounts are eligible for legacy pricing? Also, what happens to outstanding promotional credits?
Anita: Grandfathering set to accounts created <= 2024-12-31. Promo credits remain applied until they expire; for eligible accounts we'll apply a 60-day protected window where we block upward price migration.
Leo: Canary size? we should cap spend and set monitoring alerts. Don't want surprise vendor charges.
Anita: Canary = 40 customers. Per-customer token cap = 400k/day. Auto-rollback rules: if spend delta > 20% vs baseline OR error rate > 0.8% within the first 2 hours.
Priya: For reconciliation, I'll run the shadow-invoice job and produce a CSV diff. I'll include columns: account_id, sku, baseline_unit, variant_unit, baseline_line_total, variant_line_total, delta.
OpsBot: [system] Shadow-run queued: shadow_invoice_2201 scheduled for 2026-03-04T05:00:00Z.
Leo: Where should approvals be collected? FinanceOps + Vendor legal + PM?
FinanceOps: Yes. Add signoffs as comments on the experiment doc (link posted). We need explicit approve/deny text. No promotion without all three.
VendorRep: I'll request vendor-legal signoff and attach a one-paragraph memo confirming limited scope.
Anita: I'll update the rollout playbook: steps, rollback commands, monitoring dashboards, cost caps, and the exact cohort list.
Priya: I'll own the reconciliation run and will post the diff CSV to the doc and tag @finance-approvals and @billing-team by 08:00 PT.
Leo: Add an in-product banner for sandbox accounts stating "participating in pricing experiment". PM to provide copy.
Anita: Agree. Also adding a retention note: shadow invoices retained 30 days then purged.
OpsBot: [system] shadow_invoice_2201 started at 2026-03-04T05:00:03Z
Priya: Shadow job started cleanly. Running diffs now; ETA 12 minutes.
VendorRep: Vendor-legal asked for the memo to include the rollback guarantee. Drafting now.
Anita: TL;DR recap: 22:00 PT sandbox flip, 40-account canary, shadow invoices run, diff owned by Priya, vendor memo and three approvals required, spend & error rollback rules in place.
Leo: :thumbsup: Monitoring will watch token spend and invoice deltas.
FinanceOps: Noted. We'll block promotion to production until signoffs are present in the doc.
Priya: Diff complete. Uploading CSV and summary -> summary: average per-account delta = +11.2%, median = +9.6%, 3 accounts > 25% flagged for review.
Anita: Thanks. I'll review flagged accounts and ping product.
VendorRep: Vendor-legal signed off. Posting attestation to the doc.
Anita: Once FinanceOps signs, we can proceed with the scheduled sandbox activation.
FinanceOps: Signed-off (finance lead). Marking as approved in doc.
Anita: Great, proceeding with the sandbox exposure at 22:00 PT. I'll post a quick follow-up once live.
OpsBot: [system] sandbox exposure executed at 2026-03-04T22:00:00Z (run_id: exp_2201).
Anita: Live now for the 40 customers. Monitoring in place.
Leo: Watching alerts. Will report any invoice anomalies immediately.
Priya: Will keep posting periodic diff snapshots to the doc.
Anita: Closing here unless issues pop up. Thanks team!
